def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_groups = _groups(h, [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1])
    col_groups = _groups(w, [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1])
    vals = [grid[r][c] for rg in row_groups for cg in col_groups for r in rg for c in cg]
    counts = Counter(vals)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    mark = next((v for v, _ in counts.most_common() if v != background), background)
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c] == mark for r in rg for c in cg) == 2 else background
             for cg in col_groups] for rg in row_groups]

def _groups(n, separators):
    groups=[]
    start=0
    for x in separators:
        if x > start:
            groups.append(list(range(start,x)))
        start=x+1
    if start<n:
        groups.append(list(range(start,n)))
    return groups
